scope: Frozen PTv3 information-availability experiment, development only; not a new model training run
motivation: Late pooled-feature memory and track-confirmed admission did not produce reliable semantic gains. Check whether aligned raw historical geometry supplies useful information before changing learned architecture.
data: All 12 already inspected development scenes (483 frames), same calibrated raw scans and causal cached visual associations. New holdout remains unopened.
network: Original frozen B0 PTv3 weights and preprocessing, half precision and serialization shuffle disabled; no learned instance head
geometry: Supplied ego poses as in the existing semantic pilot. Same visual-track IDs and raw 3D component centers estimate translation, with 35 m/s bound; no GT instance IDs, semantic labels or ground-truth object motion. Historical object components without a current visual counterpart are excluded in all history arms. Unknown moving points remain a stated limitation.
invariants: Current input rows remain first and bit-identical. Historical points stay within current bounds, pass current 40 cm voxel support, and cannot replace existing current 5 cm voxel representatives. Store only raw scans and visual association geometry; no fused predictions or future frames. Memory is reset between scenes.
scores: Full-scan native16 mIoU, per-class/scene counts, temporal label agreement on official instances as a diagnostic, corrections and newly wrong points, actual per-forward and context-preparation timing. Semantic label agreement is not identity tracking accuracy.
gate: Continue toward independent validation only if aligned history improves full-scan mIoU by at least 0.5 pp overall and improves a majority of development logs, with no more than 0.1 pp worst-log loss. This is only a semantic evidence gate; the full goal also requires independent instance-identity gains and online runtime validation.
resources: No new training. One local GPU job, one CPU core at low priority. Log cold start and p95; do not add the four experimental forwards together and call that deployment cost, nor hide preparation/association cost.
